# #2793: Patch: card animations for the Core set
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

## What it does

This part fills in the Core set's card animation table, `apps/web/src/fx/cards/core.json5` (#2784), for #2782.

Core has 100 cards (`core-001` to `core-100`) and 11 tokens:

- 63 are Spells, Field Spells, Traps or Field Traps; 16 of them are Field Spells.
- 25 are Units with a Cry, Death, trigger or Activate in their text.

Today almost every Core entry is `"none: pending"`. Hinder (core-021), Blood Ridden Glowy Jelly Bean (core-027) and Ceaseless Void (core-100) are already bespoke.

Read `docs/polish/9-card-animations.md` and `docs/issues-and-patches.md`'s "A task over every card" first. This is a pass over every card.

### The measure

- **Spells and Traps.** Every Spell, Field Spell, Trap and Field Trap gets a motif, or a bespoke key, on its `cast` hook.
- **Units with hooks.** Every Unit whose Cry, Death, trigger or Activate changes the board gets a motif on that hook. A hook with no visible outcome may be `"none: <reason>"`.
- **Field Spells.** Every Field Spell also gets an `aura` entry (#2787 draws it).
- **Plain Units.** A vanilla Unit may be `"none: vanilla"`.
- **Tokens.** A token gets an entry only where it earns one.
- **Picking a motif.** Pick from `cargo jackioh fx census` (#2788) for Core, never from comparing card texts. Override the census's suggestion only with a reason in the table.
- **Palette.** Use a sub-look (#2792) wherever two neighbouring cards of one flavor would otherwise look alike.
- **Scale.** Set it from cost and rarity, as the doc says. Don't hand-tune per card.
- **Bespoke cards.** Give 3 to 6 Core cards a bespoke Flourish (Epic, Legendary or a marquee Rare), each built from the motif primitives with no new rendering tech. Each needs a one-line reason in the PR.
- **Legendary and Mythic entrances.** #2722's entrance and takeover animations are open to change (#2782); the owner finds them weak. A Legendary's or Mythic's Flourish may restyle its own entrance, and a Mythic its own takeover look, where the shared one doesn't suit the card. Do it through this set's table and its `fx/cards/<set>/` recipes; the shared takeover and the shared Legendary entrance in `fx/takeover.ts` are #2803's to rework. Keep the music (R2722000), when and for whom an entrance plays (R2722002) and the one capped hold (R2722001, as #2785 generalizes it). Update the tests that pin what you change, and amend R2722001 in this part's ruling note. Ceaseless Void's (core-100) is #2800's.
- **New motifs.** If 3 or more cards fit no motif, add one by the doc's "When to add a motif" rule, in its own commit, rather than going bespoke card by card.
- **Set pieces.** List set-piece candidates (wipes, game-ending moments) in the PR and give them a motif for now. Twisting Nether (core-088) and Ceaseless Void (core-100) are the board-wipe part's (F) to build.

### The deliverable

The PR holds a table with one row per Core card: the id and name, each hook, the motif, palette and scale or the key or the `none` reason, the census suggestion, and why. A reviewer must be able to check every card from it.

## Acceptance

- [ ] `core.json5` gives at least 55% of Core's 100 cards (55 or more) an entry other than `none`, and every Spell, Field Spell, Trap and Field Trap has a `cast` entry. A per-set test enforces this floor.
- [ ] Every Field Spell has an `aura` entry.
- [ ] 3 to 6 bespoke Flourishes, each with a vitest pinning its cues and an R200 check, built from motif primitives.
- [ ] The PR's per-card table, generated from the census plus the overrides, covers all 100 cards.
- [ ] No hidden card keys an entry (R202). The existing Hinder, Blood Bean and Void tests still pass.
- [ ] The `/dev/fx` gallery can play every Core entry.
- [ ] Every number is a named constant (CLAUDE.md rule 9).
- [ ] Web typecheck, tests and eslint pass, and the hotseat smoke settles.

## Blocked by, part of

Blocked by #2786, #2788, #2783 and #2792. Part of #2782.

## Goal

Fill Core's animation table, `apps/web/src/fx/cards/core.json5`, using the motif suggestions from the census tool (`cargo jackioh fx census`):

- **Spells and Traps.** Every Spell, Field Spell, Trap and Field Trap gets a `cast` entry: a motif, a bespoke recipe or a set piece. Every Field Spell also gets an `aura`.
- **Units.** Each Unit hook that changes the board gets a motif, or a `none` with its reason. In all, 87 of the 100 cards get an entry other than `none`; the required floor is 55.
- **Bespoke.** Three cards get custom Flourishes built only from the existing motif building blocks: #83 Transmogulate, #97 Zephrys and #99 Craft a Card.
- **New motifs.** Three events that no motif reads each come up on three or more Core cards, so each gets a new shared motif:
  - `send`: reads `addedToHand` and `shuffledIn`.
  - `radiance`: reads `radiantSet`.
  - `mend`: reads `healed`.
- **Per-card table.** A committed table, `fx/cards/core.md`, has one row per card. A new per-set test checks it against `core.json5` and enforces the floor.
- **Gallery.** `/dev/fx` can play every Core entry.
- **No ruling.** No entrance or takeover is restyled, so R2722001 stays as it is and no ruling note is needed.

## Steps

1. **`fx/constants.ts`.**
   - Add `send: 0, radiance: 0.15, mend: 0` at the end of `FX_MOTIF_TRAUMA`.
   - After `FX_MOTIF_TITHE_MAX`, add:
     ```ts
     // #2793: Core's flourishes (fx/cards/core/): each shake at Land; how far in from the board's edges Craft a Card's halves start.
     export const FX_TIDE_TRAUMA = 0.35;
     export const FX_WISH_TRAUMA = 0.3;
     export const FX_FORGE_TRAUMA = 0.4;
     export const FX_FORGE_REACH = 0.2;
     // #2793: the share of a set's non-token cards its pass gives an entry other than `none`.
     export const FX_SET_PASS_FLOOR = 0.55;
     ```
   - Copy all of these values into the `S2` table in `constants.test.ts`, and add `FX_FORGE_REACH` to its `fractions` list.

2. **New motifs.**
   - **Common shape.** Copy the structure of `conjure` and `tally`. All three use `replaces: []`, so each event's own row recipe still plays.
     - Use `t = timesOf(entry.durationMs)`.
     - Loop over each hit `h` of `readEvents(entry, view, env, READS)`.
     - End each motif with `...motifShake(spec, t.L)`.
   - **`send`** (in `hand.ts`) reads `addedToHand` and `shuffledIn`. For each hit:
     - Set `from = sourceOf(h.event, view, env) ?? tid(testid.hero(sideOf(view, h.event.player)))`.
     - Push `motifBurst(spec, from, "point", t.G, MOTIF_TUNING.small)`.
     - If `flies(from, h.at)`, push a `ghost` from `from` to `h.at` with `delayMs: t.T` and `durationMs: t.L - t.T`.
     - Push `motifBurst(spec, h.at, "point", t.L, MOTIF_TUNING.small, "sparkle")`.
   - **`radiance`** (in `life.ts`) reads `radiantSet`. For each hit:
     - Push a `sheen` at `h.at`, from T to L.
     - Push `motifBurst(spec, h.at, "area", t.L, MOTIF_TUNING.land)`.
     - On the first hit only, also push `raysCue(t.D, "radiant", h.at, t.L)`.
   - **`mend`** (in `life.ts`) reads `healed`. For each hit:
     - Push the same sheen as `radiance`.
     - Push `motifBurst(…, "ring", t.L, MOTIF_TUNING.land)`.
     - Push `motifRing(spec, t.D, h.at, t.L)`.
     - Push `motifBurst(…, "area", t.Li, MOTIF_TUNING.linger)`.
   - **Register them.** Add the three names after `"snap"` in `FX_MOTIF_NAMES` (before `"aura"`) and in `FX_DRAWN_MOTIFS`. Add the three planners to `MOTIF_PLANNERS`.
   - **Gallery fixtures.** Add these cases to `motifFixture`:
     - `send`: an `addedToHand` with `instanceId: "fx-added"` and `defId: "core-055"`.
     - `radiance`: a `radiantSet` of the viewer's first hand card, with `zone: { z: "hand", player: view.viewer }`.
     - `mend`: a `healed` of the viewer's first unit, `amount: 3`.
   - **Pinned cues.** Add to `PINNED` in `motifs.test.ts`:
     - `send: ["burst@0","ghost@80","burst@240"]`
     - `radiance: ["sheen@80","burst@240","rays@240","shake@240"]`
     - `mend: ["sheen@80","burst@240","ring@240","burst@300"]`

3. **Flourishes** (in `fx/cards/core/`).
   - **Rules for all three.**
     - Each is a `CardRecipe` that returns `{ cues, row: "keep" }`, or `null` for any event it does not handle.
     - Times come from `timesOf(p.D)`. Particle counts come only from `MOTIF_TUNING`.
     - Each file's header comment gives a one-line reason the card is bespoke.
   - **`flourish.ts`** exports `flourishSpec(p, play): CueSpec`, which returns:
     - `look`: `flavorLookOf(play.defId, play.instanceId, p.view) ?? FLAVOR_LOOKS[FLAVOR_FALLBACK]`
     - `scale`: `motifScale(play.defId, p.view, p.env.intensity)`
     - `row`: `"keep"`
   - **`legendaryTide`** (`transmogulate.ts`) handles `transformed`.
     - **Reason:** its transforms land in a hand and a deck that the board does not show.
     - **First transform:** if this event is the first `transformed` in `p.entry` and `isFirstEntry(p.env, p.entry, ["transformed"])` holds, then for the caster's library pile and then the caster's hand pile, push:
       - `raysCue(p.D, "legendary", pile, t.T)`
       - `motifRing(spec, p.D, pile, t.L)`
       - `motifBurst(spec, pile, "area", t.L, MOTIF_TUNING.land, "gold")`

       After both piles, push `shakeCues(spec.scale, FX_TIDE_TRAUMA, t.L)`.
     - **Each transform the viewer can read:** skip it if `hiddenFrom` includes the viewer. Otherwise look up `locateInstance(view, newInstanceId) ?? locateInstance(view, instanceId)`. If the result starts with `"hand-card-"`, push a sheen there (T to L) and a small `"sparkle"` burst at L.
   - **`perfectWish`** (`zephrys.ts`) handles the caster's own `addedToHand`.
     - **Reason:** the "perfect" card blows in from the other side.
     - **Cues:** let `far` be the other hero and `hand` the caster's hand pile, then push in this order:
       - a gather `"star"` burst at `far` (G)
       - `motifShot(spec, "bolt", far, hand, t.T, t.L - t.T)`
       - `raysCue(p.D, "mythic", hand, t.L)`
       - a land `"star"` area burst at `hand` (L)
       - `motifRing` at `hand` (L)
       - a linger `"gold"` ring burst at `hand` (Li)
       - `shakeCues(…FX_WISH_TRAUMA, t.L)`
   - **`fusionForge`** (`craftACard.ts`).
     - **Reason:** two Discovered Units fuse off the board, and no motif reads `fused`.
     - **Anchors:** let `centre = tid(testid.board, FX_CENTER)` and `edge(x) = tid(testid.board, { x, y: FX_CENTER.y })`.
     - **On `fused`,** push:
       - gather bursts at `edge(FX_FORGE_REACH)` and `edge(1 - FX_FORGE_REACH)`
       - two `motifShot` bolts from those edges to `centre` (start T, flight L−T)
       - a `nova` area burst and a `motifRing` at `centre` (L)
       - `shakeCues(…FX_FORGE_TRAUMA, t.L)`
     - **On the caster's `addedToHand`,** push a `ghost` from `centre` to the hand pile (T to L) and a small sparkle there (L).
   - **Register** all three in `CARD_RECIPES` in `bespoke.ts`.

4. **`gallery.ts`.** Export:
   - **`GalleryCardPlay`** (how the gallery plays an entry), one of:
     - `board{motif}`: a motif on `cast` or `cry`.
     - `director{motif, palette}`: the first drawn motif on `death`, `trigger` or `activate`. The palette is the hook's own, else the card's flavor, else `FLAVOR_FALLBACK`.
     - `recipe{key}`: a bespoke card recipe.
     - `setPiece`.
     - `aura`: an entry with only an aura.
   - **`galleryPlayOf(defId, entry)`** returns the play, or null for `none` entries and for bespoke entrances. A `cast`/`cry` motif wins over the other hooks, and any hook wins over an aura.
   - **`RECIPE_FIXTURES: { [K in CardRecipeKey]: (view, instanceId, player) => GameEvent[] }`**:
     - `manaCrack`: an added `nextTurnMana` `modifierChanged` for the other player.
     - `bloodDrain`: the radiance fixture, plus a `healthLost` of 3.
     - `crushingWalls`: the `wipe` fixture.
     - `legendaryTide`: a `transformed` of the viewer's first hand card, with `toDefId: "core-052"` and the same id.
     - `perfectWish`: an `addedToHand`.
     - `fusionForge`: a `fused` (`["fx-half-a","fx-half-b"]` into `"fx-fused"`, `defId: "core-055"`), then its `addedToHand`.

     - `board`: the motif's fixture.
     - `recipe`: `RECIPE_FIXTURES[key]`.
     - `setPiece`: a `hookResolving` (`sourceId` the play's id, `controller: player`, `hook: "cry"`), then the `wipe` fixture.
     - `aura`: nothing at all; it returns `[]`.
   - **`galleryFieldView(defId, view)`**: for a Field Spell or Field Trap, it replaces `you.backrow[0]` with `{ ...it, defId, type }`, so the card stands face up and its aura shows. For any other card it returns the view unchanged.

5. **`routes/dev/fx.tsx`.**

7. **`core.md`.**

   - **Header.** Name the base commit.
   - **Rows.** Write one row per Core id, in catalog order: ``| `core-001` | Big D-fender | Unit | <entry> | <scale> | <census> | <why> |``.

     - **scale:** `motifScale(id, fullBoardView(), 1).toFixed(2)`, or `—` for a `none`.
     - **census:** the census's "Suggested" cell, copied exactly, or `not in census` for the 7 tokens it does not list.
   - **Why codes.** Write the code out as a sentence:
     - `=` the census agrees;
     - `S` the census skips events on the card itself;
     - `F` a Field Spell's cast is its own landing;
     - `T` a Trap's cast is its firing, which plans nothing until firings open a window;
     - `N` the census predates the motif that reads this event (name both);
     - `Z` the suggestion is noise in the window (fatigue, other cards' events);
     - `H` the census never saw the hook fire;
     - `K` keywords only;
     - `B` bespoke;
     - `X` the reason given inline.
